comment: Which animation goes under an A+ in the animated export, keyed by category. Served as-is by GET /api/gif-rules and resolved against Drive metadata by POST /api/gif-match. Owned by the Export panel. Convention: a category with no explicit rule uses the file named after the category in the source folder (Running -> Running.mp4 or Running.gif), case-insensitive, extension chosen by `prefer`.

output.comment: House format for a finished A+ GIF (example in Drive: 708202.gif). Encoding happens on the user's device.
output.layout: static A+ on top, animation full-width below
